node.statement: Fix k >= 0 and put V=A^k=H^k(M;reals) and W_p=F^{p,k-p}. Then W_0=V, W_{p+1} is contained in W_p, W_{k+1}=0, sigma^{*k} preserves every W_p, and W_p/W_{p+1}=E^{p,k-p}; thus (W_p)_{p=0}^{k+1} is a finite sigma^{*k}-invariant filtration of the finite-dimensional real vector space V.
